task_instance: Given messy, informally-described notes about an 'Employee Expense Reimbursement' process (submission, manager approval, Finance policy check/coding, VP sign-off over $2,000, missing-receipt affidavit exception under $75, international currency conversion, bi-weekly payment run), produce a complete SOP document following the skill's exact output template: Purpose, Scope, RACI Matrix, Process Flow (ASCII flowchart), Detailed Steps per stage, Exceptions and Edge Cases table, Metrics table, and Related Documents.
evidence: Wrote input notes to process_input_notes.md simulating a user's rough description of the process. Wrote the full SOP deliverable to Employee_Expense_Reimbursement_SOP.md, matching every section of the skill's specified output format (Owner/Last Updated/Review Cadence header, Purpose, Scope with in/out of scope, a 6-row RACI Matrix, an ASCII Process Flow diagram with branching for approval/rejection and the VP sign-off exception, 6 Detailed Steps each with Who/When/How/Output, a 6-row Exceptions and Edge Cases table capturing all exceptions mentioned in the notes (missing receipt affidavit under $75, VP sign-off over $2,000, international currency conversion, personal-expense mixups, rejection loop), a Metrics table (noting the input's stated fact that turnaround isn't currently tracked, and recommending a baseline), and a Related Documents list. Read the file back to confirm it was written correctly and is well-formed markdown. This is a pure text-authoring deliverable requiring no code execution, no binary output, and no connector/MCP calls, so it is fully achievable within the office-assistant runtime's read/write/edit-text-files capability.
